# Environment assets for the photo-style renders

Used by `../src/blend_photo.py`. Both are from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) and are **CC0** (public domain): free for commercial use, no attribution required.

| File | Asset | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `shudu_lake_2k.hdr` | HDRI "Shudu Lake" (2K) | Overcast sky, lake and hills: lighting, reflections and the background above the horizon |
| `asphalt_pit_lane_diff_2k.jpg`, `_rough_2k.jpg`, `_nor_gl_2k.jpg` | Texture "Asphalt Pit Lane" (2K) | The ground plane |

The ground plane covers the HDRI's own foreground, so below the horizon the picture shows the asphalt, fading into a light haze with distance.
